description.value: The study examined whether self-appraisal deficits in behavioural-variant frontotemporal degeneration are domain-specific or multi-domain and related self-appraisal discrepancy scores to grey matter density using voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: We examined whether a domain-specific versus multi-domain model best explains degraded self-appraisal in bvFTD.

value: We hypothesised that only bvFTD would demonstrate a self-appraisal deficit in multiple cognitive domains, and that this multi-domain deficit would be associated with changes in ventral medial PFC.
